_what: The licence audit of every upstream project this library may read from. `deps.json` answers 'what do we link';
this file answers the other question a compliance reviewer asks: before reading another FOC project closely,
vendoring it, or copying a function out of it, what is its licence and what does that licence let us do.
The site page is rendered from this file by `deps_gate.py --render`; nothing in it is typed into prose.
`deps.json` 回答“我们链接了什么”；本文件回答合规审阅者的另一个问题：在细读、引入或摘抄另一个 FOC 项目之前，
它的许可是什么、允许我们做什么。站点页面由 `deps_gate.py --render` 从本文件生成，没有任何一条是手打进散文的。
_why_here: It lives in `.github/project/` because it is project-private rule data: the gate that enforces the same rule
(`gates.py license` over `.github/misc/.license-guard.txt`) is here too, and a documentation tree can be
rewritten without touching it. 它放在 `.github/project/`，因为它是项目私域的规则数据：执行同一条规则的门禁也在这里，
而文档树可以整个重写而不碰它。

yes.en: may be vendored, keep the notice

use.en: Behaviour spec and the HAL breadth checklist. **Not code**: its Arduino/global-object model conflicts with the rule that `include/` is allocation-free and exception-free, and with policy composition having no globals.
use.zh: 行为规格与 HAL 广度清单。**不引代码**：其 Arduino/全局对象模型与“`include/` 不分配、不抛异常”以及“策略组合不用全局”两条约束冲突。

use.en: The best reference for the command surface — field semantics, `NaN` meaning hold position, the gain scales — and for the field-weakening calibration flow. Same licence family as ours.
use.zh: 命令面语义（字段含义、`NaN` 表示保持位置、增益缩放）与弱磁标定流程的最佳参考，且与本库同族许可。

use.en: Capability and parameter **semantics only**. Copyleft is viral and would end the Apache-2.0 licence and any commercial use: do not copy code *or comments*, write the behaviour down as our own test and satisfy that.
use.zh: 只对标能力与参数**语义**。传染性 copyleft 会终结本库的 Apache-2.0 与商业可用性：**连注释都不要抄**，把行为写成我们自己的测试再满足它。

use.en: Reference for 'low-cost hardware, no current loop' only. The network clause is poison for a library.
use.zh: 仅作“低成本硬件、无电流环”的参考。网络条款对库是毒药。

use.en: Thinking reference only: never in the build, never in the library. `conventions.rst` records why it is also the one external reference whose numbers this project refuses to compare against.
use.zh: 只作思路参考：不进构建、不进库。它也是本库拒绝与之比数字的唯一外部参考，原因见 `conventions.rst`。

projects.evidence: LICENSE.md first line, Copyright (c) 2016-2018 ODrive Robotics, repo 3a2e4dd1; three web fetches had failed before a clone worked

use.en: Behaviour spec first — spinout detection, input modes, anticogging, the torque-mode velocity limiter. Code only with the notice. Verified by cloning, which also pins the commit the conclusion rests on.
use.zh: 先作行为规格：spinout 检测、输入模式、anticogging、力矩模式限速。引代码须保留声明。用克隆核实，顺带把结论所依据的 commit 钉住。

use.en: Treat like ODrive until verified: behaviour first, code never.
use.zh: 核实前与 ODrive 同处理：行为优先，代码不碰。

projects.evidence: LICENSE in the conan package, © John Wellbelove and contributors

use.en: An internal dependency and an independent witness: `src/**` and the tests may include it, a public header may not. The cross-check cases are the point — our CRC agrees with theirs byte for byte. The measured cost of the other choice is in `deps.json`.
use.zh: 内部依赖兼独立证人：`src/**` 与测试可以 include，公开头不行。价值在对拍用例——我们的 CRC 与它逐字节一致。另一种选择的实测代价在 `deps.json`。

title.en: Two ways to integrate, and only one is about code
title.zh: 两种“接入”，只有一种涉及代码

en: **Behaviour integration, always allowed.** Write our own test that encodes what the other project guarantees, then satisfy it. No licence question arises, and the test is the artefact that survives.

**Code integration, permissive licences only.** Copy, keep the notice, extend `NOTICE`, and let `gates.py license` keep everyone honest. A vendored subtree that is legitimately copyleft needs a scope line in `.github/misc/.license-guard.txt` and an entry in `NOTICE`; the library default stays permissive.
zh: **行为接入，永远可行。** 把对方承诺的行为写成我们自己的测试，然后满足它。完全不涉及许可问题，留下的产物就是测试。
**代码接入，仅限宽松许可。** 复制、保留声明、扩 `NOTICE`，并让 `gates.py license` 守住。确实需要 copyleft 子目录时，在 `.github/misc/.license-guard.txt` 加作用域行并在 `NOTICE` 登记；库本身默认仍是宽松许可。

title.en: How to verify a licence: clone it, do not fetch it
title.zh: 怎么核实许可：克隆，别抓网页

en: A web fetch cannot extract a plain-text `LICENSE`, and a clone also pins the exact commit the conclusion rests on — which a web page never does. `workspace/` is git-ignored, so the reference copy never reaches a commit, but the conclusion and the commit hash do.
zh: 网页抓取无法提取纯文本 `LICENSE`；克隆还能给出结论所依据的确切 commit，而网页永远给不出。`workspace/` 已被 gitignore，参考副本不会进提交，但结论与 commit 哈希会进。

en: Driving hardware designed for another project needs no licence at all, and it is the cheapest real integration available: implement the five HAL interfaces (`Pwm`, `CurrentSense`, `PositionSensor`, `DcLink`, `Clock`) for that board and the library serves it.
zh: 为别人的项目设计的硬件写驱动不涉及任何许可，而且这是最便宜的真实接入：为那块板子实现五个 HAL 接口（`Pwm`、`CurrentSense`、`PositionSensor`、`DcLink`、`Clock`），库就能服务它。
